objectives.title: Closed circuits
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: understand that a closed circuit permits current to flow. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code. Alignment remains subject to teacher review.

objectives.title: Electrical conductors and insulators
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: identify electrical conductors and insulators. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code. The demonstration tests inference from observations, not a practical construction skill.

assessment.title: PSLE Science — for examination from 2026
assessment.note: The demonstration borrows the four-option, two-mark MCQ format and application/data-interpretation objective. It is a P5 practice item, not an official PSLE question. Source requirements do not establish empirical difficulty or originality.
